episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: After a chance meeting at a party, Justin and Keisha catch feelings fast. But a misunderstanding could destroy their romance before it even starts.

episodes.title: Ghosted
episodes.summary: Justin loses phone privileges, complicating his attempt to reconnect with Keisha — who's going through it after her ex suddenly reappears.

episodes.title: Fourth Quarter
episodes.summary: Keisha confronts Christian about the damage he's done to her reputation. With college applications looming, Justin faces pressure on and off the court.

episodes.title: Run It Back
episodes.summary: As Keisha grows closer to Justin, his family welcomes her with open arms. But when it comes to Keisha's mom, things aren't so simple.

episodes.title: The Vineyard
episodes.summary: Keisha and Chloe head to Martha's Vineyard on a mission. A withdrawn Justin must decide whether to open back up after heartbreak.

episodes.title: The Honeymoon
episodes.summary: Dawn issues a brutal ultimatum to Justin — with the potential to damage Keisha's relationship with Shelly.

episodes.title: Deep End
episodes.summary: As college admissions season heats up, Keisha and Justin begin to realize that the futures they've been striving for could drive them apart.

episodes.title: Forever...
episodes.summary: A tough prom-night conversation forces Justin to make a choice. Can he follow his dreams without breaking his parents' hearts — or Keisha's?
